properties.description: LEHD LODES8 Illinois main OD (JT00, all jobs, 2021) aggregated from blocks to 2020 tract-to-tract flows between the Chicago tracts; the top 40,000 non-self flows by jobs. Origin = home, destination = work. Totals for all tracts are in the per-tract columns.
properties.licence: US Census Bureau LEHD LODES, public domain (attribute: U.S. Census Bureau, LEHD Origin-Destination Employment Statistics)
storyNotes: 139,015 tract pairs have commuters inside Chicago; the top 40,000 flows keep 80% of inter-tract Chicago-internal jobs.
Busiest workplace tract: 17031839100 with 314,988 jobs (the Loop / downtown core); 1,322,328 jobs across city tracts.
Largest single flow: 2,033 workers from tract 17031081800 to 17031839100.
In kept flows 66% of jobs are high-earning (>$3,333/mo) and 11% low-earning; the earnings split is in the three earnings columns.
17,255 workers live and work in the same tract (excluded from flows).
LODES blocks are noise-infused for privacy, so small flows are fuzzed; aggregate to tracts (as here) for stable estimates.
